query:
SELECT id, title, CHAR_LENGTH(content) as len,
  (CHAR_LENGTH(content) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '- ', ''))) / 2 as bullet_count,
  (CHAR_LENGTH(content) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '## ', ''))) / 3 as section_count
FROM course_lessons 
WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(content) < 8000
ORDER BY len ASC LIMIT 10;
